text: Target-bound serialized SMIL/objects shall record sufficient resolved contract identities/digests, CPU requirements, and exposed-interface information to reproduce and validate target-dependent decisions. Changing layout/ABI shall invalidate every dependent transformation rather than merely replace an identifier.
